title: Batch 3 concrete paraphrases for generic Chronicles persons_2 facts

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは焼き尽くす献げ物と和解の献げ物を終えると、主の名によって民を祝福します。
changes.sourceText: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.
changes.previousContext: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
changes.nextContext: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: レビ人の一部は主の箱の前で仕え、イスラエルの神である主に感謝し、賛美する務めを担います。
changes.sourceText: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
changes.previousContext: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.
changes.nextContext: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 祭司ベナヤとヤハジエルは、神の契約の箱の前で絶えずラッパを吹きます。
changes.sourceText: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
changes.previousContext: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;
changes.nextContext: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデはこの日、アサフとその兄弟たちを通して主への感謝を始めさせます。
changes.sourceText: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
changes.previousContext: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.
changes.nextContext: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 歌は主への感謝と御名を呼び求めること、主の行いを諸国に知らせることを促します。
changes.sourceText: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.
changes.previousContext: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.
changes.nextContext: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 歌は、主の聖なる名を誇り、主を求める人々が喜ぶよう呼びかけます。
changes.sourceText: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
changes.previousContext: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.
changes.nextContext: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 歌は、主とその力を求め、絶えず御顔を尋ねるよう促します。
changes.sourceText: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
changes.previousContext: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
changes.nextContext: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 歌は主を「私たちの神」と呼び、その裁きが全地に及ぶと述べます。
changes.sourceText: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.
changes.previousContext: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
changes.nextContext: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 全地に主へ歌い、日ごとに主の救いを告げ知らせるよう呼びかけます。
changes.sourceText: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.
changes.previousContext: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”
changes.nextContext: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 歌は、主が大いなる方で賛美されるべきであり、すべての神々にまさって恐れられると述べます。
changes.sourceText: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
changes.previousContext: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.
changes.nextContext: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 諸国の神々は偶像だが、主は天を造った方だと歌われます。
changes.sourceText: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
changes.previousContext: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.
changes.nextContext: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 諸国の民の氏族に、主へ栄光と力を帰すよう呼びかけます。
changes.sourceText: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
changes.previousContext: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.
changes.nextContext: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 主の御名にふさわしい栄光を主に帰し、献げ物を携えて御前に来て礼拝するよう歌います。
changes.sourceText: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.
changes.previousContext: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
changes.nextContext: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 天と地に喜ぶよう呼びかけ、諸国の間で「主は王」と告げる歌です。
changes.sourceText: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
changes.previousContext: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.
changes.nextContext: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 森の木々も主の前で喜び歌うとされ、主が地を裁くため来られると述べます。
changes.sourceText: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
changes.previousContext: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!
changes.nextContext: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 主は善い方で、その慈しみはとこしえに続くとして、感謝を促します。
changes.sourceText: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
changes.previousContext: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.
changes.nextContext: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 民は救いの神に、諸国から集めて救い、御名に感謝できるよう願います。
changes.sourceText: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
changes.previousContext: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
changes.nextContext: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: イスラエルの神である主を永遠から永遠までほめたたえ、民は「アーメン」と応えて主を賛美します。

changes.previousContext: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
changes.nextContext: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: アサフと兄弟たちは、日々の務めとして主の契約の箱の前で仕えるためそこに残されます。
changes.sourceText: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;
changes.previousContext: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
changes.nextContext: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 祭司ザドクとその兄弟たちは、ギブオンの高き所にある主の幕屋の前に置かれます。
changes.sourceText: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
changes.previousContext: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;
changes.nextContext: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 彼らは主の律法に記された命令に従い、朝夕に焼き尽くす献げ物を主の祭壇でささげます。
changes.sourceText: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;
changes.previousContext: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,
changes.nextContext: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

changes.afterTextJa: ヘマン、エドトンらは名を挙げて選ばれ、主の慈しみが永遠に続くことを感謝します。
changes.sourceText: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ヘマンとエドトンはラッパやシンバルを鳴らし、神への歌に用いる楽器を担当し、エドトンの子らは門に立ちます。
changes.sourceText: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.
changes.previousContext: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;
changes.nextContext: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ダビデは、契約の箱が天幕にある一方、自分は杉の家に住むことを預言者ナタンに話します。
changes.sourceText: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”
changes.previousContext: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.
changes.nextContext: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: ナタンはダビデに、心にあることを行うよう勧め、神が共におられると告げます。
changes.sourceText: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
changes.previousContext: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”
changes.nextContext: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: その夜、神の言葉がナタンに臨みます。
changes.sourceText: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
changes.previousContext: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”
changes.nextContext: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 主はナタンを通して、ダビデは主のための家を建てないと告げます。
changes.sourceText: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;
changes.previousContext: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
changes.nextContext: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 万軍の主は、ダビデを羊の群れの後ろから取り、イスラエルの君主にしたと語ります。
changes.sourceText: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.
changes.previousContext: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’
changes.nextContext: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 主はダビデに、敵を従わせ、主が彼のために家を建てると約束します。
changes.sourceText: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.
changes.previousContext: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,
changes.nextContext: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

changes.beforeText: 後の記載でもGodの名が挙がります。
changes.afterTextJa: 主はダビデの後継者について、自分が父となり彼が子となると述べ、慈しみを取り去らないと約束します。
changes.sourceText: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;
changes.previousContext: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.
changes.nextContext: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”
